arxiv-1804-00037.title: Reactive Supervisory Control of Open Discrete Event Systems
arxiv-1804-00037.creator: Alireza Partovi, Hai Lin
arxiv-1804-00037.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Alireza Partovi, Hai Lin. The conventional Wonham-Ramadge supervisory control framework of discrete event systems enforces a closed discrete event system to generate correct behaviors under certain environments, which can be captured by an appropriate plant model. Nevertheless, such control methods cannot be directly applied for many practical engineering systems nowadays since they are open systems and their operation heavily depends on nontrivial interactions between the systems and the external environments.

arxiv-2112-11926.title: Integrable Local and Non-local Vector Non-linear Schrödinger Equation with Balanced loss and Gain
arxiv-2112-11926.creator: Debdeep Sinha
arxiv-2112-11926.description: Abstract The local and non-local vector Non-linear Schrödinger Equation (NLSE) with a general cubic non-linearity are considered in presence of a linear term characterized, in general, by a non-hermitian matrix which under certain condition incorporates balanced loss and gain and a linear coupling between the complex fields of the governing non-linear equations.

arxiv-2206-06333.title: A HC model with countable set of spin values: uncountable set of Gibbs measures
arxiv-2206-06333.creator: U. A. Rozikov, F. H. Haydarov
arxiv-2206-06333.description: Abstract . We consider a hard core (HC) model with a countable set ℤ \mathbb{Z} of spin values on the Cayley tree. This model is defined by a countable set of parameters λ i > 0 , i ∈ ℤ ∖ { 0 } \lambda_{i}>0,i\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\} .

arxiv-2305-06403.title: Sensor Observability Analysis for Maximizing Task-Space Observability of Articulated Robots
arxiv-2305-06403.creator: Christopher Yee Wong, Member, IEEE, Wael Suleiman, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2305-06403.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christopher Yee Wong, Member, IEEE, Wael Suleiman, Senior Member, IEEE. We propose a novel performance metric for articulated robots with distributed directional sensors called the sensor observability analysis (SOA). These robot-mounted distributed directional sensors (e.g., joint torque sensors) change their individual sensing directions as the joints move. SOA transforms individual sensors axes in joint space to provide the cumulative sensing quality of these sensors to observe each task-space axis, akin to forward kinematics for sensors.

arxiv-2411-08760.title: Energy Dissipation Preserving Physics Informed Neural Network for Allen-Cahn Equations
arxiv-2411-08760.creator: Mustafa Kütük, Hamdullah Yücel
arxiv-2411-08760.description: Abstract This paper investigates a numerical solution of Allen–Cahn equation with constant and degenerate mobility, with polynomial and logarithmic energy functionals, with deterministic and random initial functions, and with advective term in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, based on the physics-informed neural network (PINN).

arxiv-2503-18862.title: Exploring the Integration of Key-Value Attention Into Pure and Hybrid Transformers for Semantic Segmentation This is a preprint of the following paper: Hwa, DeShin; Holmes, Tobias; Drechsler, Klaus, ”Integration of Key-value Attention into Pure and Hybrid Transformers for Semantic Segmentation”, pub
arxiv-2503-18862.creator: DeShin Hwa, Tobias Holmes, Klaus Drechsler
arxiv-2503-18862.description: Abstract While CNNs were long considered state of the art for image processing, the introduction of Transformer architectures has challenged this position. While achieving excellent results in image classification and segmentation, Transformers remain inherently reliant on large training datasets and remain computationally expensive.

pmc-10589595.title: Molybdenum target mammography-based prediction model for metastasis of axillary sentinel lymph node in early-stage breast cancer
pmc-10589595.creator: Caixing Yuan, Guolin Xu, Xiangmei Zhan, Min Xie, Mingcong Luo, Lilan She, Yunjing Xue
pmc-10589595.description: Sentinel lymph node (SLN) status is closely related to axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer. However, SLN biopsy has certain limitations due to invasiveness and diagnostic efficiency. This study aimed to develop a model to predict the risk of axillary SLN metastasis in early-stage breast cancer based on mammography, a noninvasive, cost-effective, and potential complementary way.

pmc-11454991.title: 5178 TNFα-dependent altered miRNA expression regulates endometrial stromal cell proliferation
pmc-11454991.creator: I Chowdhury, S Banerjee, W Xu, A Driss, C Nezhat, N Sidell, R N Taylor, W E Thompson
pmc-11454991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Abstract: Aberrant upregulation of cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor α (TNFα) and activation of nuclear factor κB (NF-κB) with disbalance of microRNAs (miRNAs) are often found in endometrium of endometriosis subjects, which causes directly or indirectly pelvic inflammation, pain, and infertility, Although, the pathophysiology of endometriosis is not clearly established yet, inflammation is an essential feature. MicroRNAs are emerging as potential regulatory factors in cellular processes such as cell growth, survival, migration, and invasion.

pmc-11674115.title: Assessing the Influence of Low Doses of Sucrose on Memory Deficits in Fish Exposed to Common Insecticide Based on Fipronil and Pyriproxyfen
pmc-11674115.creator: Viorica Rarinca, Luminita Diana Hritcu, Marian Burducea, Gabriel Plavan, Radu Lefter, Vasile Burlui, Laura Romila, Alin Ciobică, Elena Todirascu-Ciornea, Cristian-Alin Barbacariu, Sherif T S Hassan
pmc-11674115.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Although pesticides have been a constant concern for decades, in the last ten years, public discussions and scientific research have emphasized their impact on human health and the environment, drawing increased attention to the problems associated with their use. The association of environmental stressors such as pesticides with a sugar-rich diet can contribute to the growing global metabolic disease epidemic through overlapping mechanisms of insulin resistance, inflammation, and metabolic dysregulation.

pmc-12045293.title: Molecular Factors Involved in the Pathogenesis of Pyometra in Domestic Cats (Felis catus)
pmc-12045293.creator: Acácia Eduarda de Jesus Nascimento, Luciano Cardoso Santos, Juneo Freitas Silva, Fiona K Hollinshead, Greg Burns, Natali Krekeler
pmc-12045293.description: Simple SummaryThis article reviews the molecular factors causing pyometra in domestic cats, a serious uterine infection. While well-studied in dogs, pyometra in cats is less understood. The focus is on hormonal, redox, immunological, and growth factors, aiming to improve the diagnosis and treatment of the disease.Keywords: feline pyometra, hormonal disorders, uterine infection, molecular factors 1.

pmc-12495821.title: Silent crisis on the frontlines: a systematic review of suicidal behaviors among disaster responders – epidemiology, risk pathways, and evidence-based interventions
pmc-12495821.creator: Shandiz Moslehi, Asghar Tavan, Mehdi Khezeli, Samira soleimanpour, Sajjad Narimani
pmc-12495821.description: BackgroundFirst responders (including paramedics, firefighters, police, and dispatchers) experience significantly elevated suicide risk due to repeated trauma exposure, high rates of PTSD and depression, and systemic barriers to mental healthcare. This systematic review examines (1) suicide prevalence, (2) psychological and occupational risk factors, and (3) interventions across different emergency service roles and global contexts.

pmc-12618301.title: A New Neotropical Species of Gnathostoma (Nematoda: Gnathostomatidae) from the Northern Four-Eyed Opossum Philander vossi (Marsupialia)
pmc-12618301.creator: M Á Mosqueda-Cabrera, E Sánchez-Miranda, L D Castillo-Loeza, G Torres-Carrera, L García-Prieto
pmc-12618301.description: PurposeThis work provides a detailed morphological description of a previously identified but unnamed lineage inside Gnathostoma spp. from Mexico.MethodsSpecimens of the four-eyed opossum Philader vossi were collected in Tlacotalpan, Veracruz, Mexico. Specimens were examined morphologically using both light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy. Additionally, we generate DNA sequences for the following loci: mitochondrial cox1 and nuclear 5.

pmc-13139546.title: To treat or not to treat? Impact of hygienization on the microbiological safety of frass from black soldier fly larvae and yellow mealworm production aimed for fertilizer use
pmc-13139546.creator: Ann De Volder, Lotte Frooninckx, David Deruytter, Johan Ceusters, Dries Vandeweyer
pmc-13139546.description: Sustainable expansion of the insect farming industry requires valorization of the generated frass, a by-product with fertilizer and soil improver potential. Commercialization is currently restricted by Regulation (EU) No 2021/1925, considering insect frass as animal manure and imposing a pathogen-reducing heat treatment.

pmc-13610670.title: Monovalent Nondegrading Molecular Glues: An Updated Overview of Emerging Mechanisms and Therapeutic Development
pmc-13610670.creator: Linfeng Li, Jiajia Li, Li Yang, Jun Zhou, Yuying Ma
pmc-13610670.description: Chemically induced proximity (CIP) has revolutionized small-molecule pharmacology by moving beyond traditional occupancy-based inhibition and activation. Within this paradigm, monovalent nondegrading molecular glues (ndMGs) represent a structurally compact and mechanistically distinct class of linkerless compounds. These agents stabilize or induce selective biomolecular interactions, altering the functional state or cellular localization of macromolecular complexes without causing component degradation.
